concerns.text: Tasks T045-T048 (Phase 6) implement a 'Failure Mode Report' and 'Jagged Line' plot in response to a 'richard-feynman-simulated' review. The Analyze Report explicitly states this review was rejected (score 0.0) and that implementing tasks based on it violates the Constitution (Principle II: Verified Accuracy). These tasks have no corresponding FR/SC in the spec.md and represent unauthorized scope creep from a rejected source.

FR-007 and US-3 Acceptance Scenario 2 mandate a sensitivity analysis sweeping correlation thresholds over ρ ∈ {0, 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9}. Task T031 explicitly implements the sweep only for ρ ∈ {0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9}, omitting the ρ=0 (independence) baseline. There is no task covering the generation or analysis of the ρ=0 case required by the spec.

FR-009 requires the system to detect when p/n > 10 OR when the covariance matrix is near-singular (condition number > 10^12). Tasks T006, T007, and T010b cover the condition number check and error raising. However, there is no task explicitly implementing the detection and handling of the p/n > 10 condition (e.g., a check in the data generation or test execution pipeline that raises the specific error or applies regularization when this ratio is exceeded).

Tasks T041-T044 are marked with '[ ]' (incomplete) but the task descriptions contain internal notes like 'SKIPPED: non-mapping output' or 'NEED RE-DO' referencing a prior state. These tasks lack a clear, actionable definition of what is currently required versus what was previously rejected, creating ambiguity in the implementation plan.
